_comment: OAI behind FlexRIC: two DUs under one CU (F1 handover) as in OAI doc/handover-tutorial.md. 'e2_node_id' is the string the FlexRIC bridge xApp uses for the E2 node (docs/RAN_INTEGRATION.md §9.4); take PLMN / nb_id from the E2 Setup that nearRT-RIC logs. Replace PCIs and NR cell ids with the values of your DU configs; the target NR-CGI of a handover is plmn + nci.
